item.title: The Crust
item.description:
Title: The Crust
Genre: Simulation , Strategy
Developer: VEOM Studio
Publisher: Crytivo
Franchise: The Crust
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 15, 2024




About This Game

1.0 OUT NOW — full campaign with multiple endings, Planning Mode, Sandbox 2.0, global events, macOS

Mine resources and automate their production processes

Mine lunar resources, craft processing machinery, and power up your base with satellites and batteries. Unlock scientific advancements across three research trees to enhance your technological capabilities.

Automate resources with conveyor belts and drones.

Streamline your resource management as you deploy conveyor belts and drones for seamless automation

Explore

Embark on lunar expeditions to unearth the moon's hidden secrets, deploying your rover to various locations and delving into the mysteries of humanity's newfound lunar habitat.

Trade Resources

Engage in resource exchange with Earth through contracts, where your decisions have the power to shape their political landscape. Choose a faction to support or navigate the field strategically for maximum profit.

Assemble a team of colonists

People are your most valuable resource. Keep track of your colonists' health, mood and needs. Hire the best experts and make sure they work as a team: it’s their unique traits and skills that will allow you to truly optimize your production and research!

Key Features

  • Build a lunar colony

  • Mine and automate resources and production

  • Explore the moon

  • Play through a rich, story driven narrative

  • Trade with Earth

  • Influence politics

  • Manage colonists and their needs

System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

item.title: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
item.description:
Title: Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone
Genre: Action , Indie , Early Access
Developer: ANB_Seth
Publisher: 2080 Games
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 10, 2026




About This Game

"Gunman Contracts – Stand Alone" is an intense, action-movie-inspired single player shooter created from the ground up for VR and Non-VR. Take on the role of “the gunman”, a professional operative feared in the criminal underworld, working for an illusive order vowed to deliver justice in a world beyond the reach of the law - one contract at a time.

From solo developer ANB_Seth, creator of the popular Half-Life: Alyx mods "Gunman Contracts – Chapter 1 & Chapter 2" , this game takes the action to the next level with a completely new, from-the-ground-up developed single-player experience.

STORY CAMPAIGN

The Gunman sets his sights on a new target: The Collectors - a ruthless crime operation killing and kidnapping innocent people for reasons yet unknown. Pick out your gear, take aim and get ready to kill your way to the dark truth behind the collectors operation. From an old Safehouse outside the city, to a warehouse district and a mob run restaurant with a dark truth kept below.

TRAIN IN "THE HIVE" - THE GUNMAN'S BASE

The gunman's base features a speed-shooting obstacle course, pop up target practice, a classic gun range, and holographic combat training. Your gun wall has 18+ weapons to unlock and a gun bench to make them your own.

CHALLENGE MODES AND LEADERBOARDS

In the Takedown-Mode you can select Enemy types, Enemy count and then clear the area. In Last Stand, survive an endless wave of hostiles and disarm bombs as long as you can. Feeling competitive, or just out for a personal best? Every contract, challenge and skill game features steam leaderboards (divided up between VR and Non-VR).

EARLY ACCESS

The game launches in Early Access with a set of 3 full story missions and challenge maps, with 3 additional story missions to be added with free future updates. However, the price of the game is set to increase as more contracts and content are added up to version 1.0. So feel free to join the party early!

LAUNCH PACKAGE

The game will release with the following content, with more (free) updates to come in the future:

  • 3 Connected Story Contracts

    - Safehouse in the city outskirts

    - Syndicate run harbor warehouse district

    - Mobster restaurant with a dark underbelly

  • The “Hive” (The Gunman's Home Base)

    - Gunwall to store and unlock weapons

    - Gun bench to skin weapons and modify gun sounds

    - Gun range with skill games and training stations

    - Holographic enemy combat area

  • Challenge Game Modes (5 Maps Available)

    - Takedown Mode: Face off against up to 30 enemies to kill in a closed area

    - Last Stand Mode: Fight against waves of enemies, disarm bombs and survive as long as you can

  • 18 Weapons To Unlock with per-weapon attachments

  • Compound Bow and Knives

  • Custom Music Feature play your own mp3 files in-game via the Gunman’s smartphone

  • Steam Achievements

  • Steam Leaderboards for every contract, skillgame and challenge

  • Unlockable Cheats

  • Optional Low-Violence Mode

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Modeld after gun blazing hollywood action thrillers, this game contains content not appropriate for all ages, and may not be appropriate for viewing at work, featuring frequent violence and general mature content.

Note: this game can also be played in a "low violence" mode, which disables nearly all blood effects and splatter, but still keeps the action intact.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: Non-VR: Intel Core i5-7500 or better
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Non-VR: GTX 1070 or better
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR: Standing / Sitting
    • Additional Notes: Tests on various systems are still in progress. These Specs are for Non-VR.
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: VR: Intel Core i7-12700 or better
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: VR: RTX 3060 or better
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • VR Support: OpenXR: Standing / Sitting
    • Additional Notes: Tests on various systems are still in progress. These Specs are for VR.

item.title: Effulgence RPG
item.description:
Title: Effulgence RPG
Genre: Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Andrei Fomin
Publisher: Andrei Fomin
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Dec 2, 2025




About This Game

A WORLD MADE OF CHARACTERS

Everything you see in Effulgence RPG is built from text characters arranged into 3D forms. Landscapes, creatures, machines and effects come to life as these forms move, rotate and transform throughout a strange sci-fi world.

ENEMIES ARE THE RESOURCE

Defeated enemies break apart into particles. Collect them and use the matter printer to create new weapons and equipment. You can even print during battle, turning fallen enemies into tools for the fights ahead.

FIGHT AS A PARTY

Control four heroes in tactical turn-based battles, each with their own strengths and abilities. Upgrade their skills, combine weapons, cartridges and mechanisms, and adapt to enemies and bosses with their own rules and mechanics.

A COMPACT RPG ADVENTURE

Effulgence RPG is a focused adventure that doesn't demand a hundred-hour commitment. A typical playthrough takes around 5–7 hours , with varied locations, story encounters, secrets and bosses along the way.

  • Three types of mini-games woven into the adventure

  • Deploy unusual mechanisms, from a combat sparrow to a flamethrower copter

  • Bosses built around unique mechanics

  • Dozens of blueprints for printable weapons, gear, and mechanisms

Descrierea conținutului pentru adulți indisponibilă.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: 8, 10, 11
    • Processor: 1.6 GHz
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Storage: 100 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: 10, 11

item.title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
item.description:
Title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics
Genre: Strategy
Developer: Blindspot Games
Publisher: Blindspot Games
Franchise: Infinity Universe , Aristeia
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026




About This Game

Turn-Based Tactical Battles

Infinity: HexaDome Tactics is a turn-based tactics game set in the Infinity universe. Lead your team through a campaign where each match reveals more of the world while unlocking new champions and cosmetics.

Challenges & Duels

Beyond the campaign, test your skills in tactical challenges with unique conditions.
Face AI, friends, or other players in duels, either in friendly matches or competitive games.

Your Team

Build your squad of champions. Each fighter has unique strengths: ranged combat, melee attacks, control, or support.
Make the right plays, impress the crowd, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities.

Tactical Management

Every action point matters. Should you attack now, capture the objective, or prepare your next move?
Use tactical cards, manage your resources, and outsmart your opponents to claim victory.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI Content Disclosure
The entire game – gameplay, features, story, dialogue, design, and UI – is made by humans. AI was used in two specific places:
1. Announcer voice (optional): All announcer lines are written by our writer; the voice is AI text-to-speech. The announcer adapts to the match by selecting from these pre-written lines. Experimental feature, can be disabled in settings.
2. Rendering assistance for the visual novel: The story and dialogue are written by our authors. All visual novel art is based on our own assets – character designs come from the official 3D models and artwork of the tabletop game, backgrounds from in-game screenshots. AI helped translate them into the novel's 2D style; every image was then retouched and corrected by our artists. Minor artifacts may remain. Spotted one? Please report it, we're actively fixing them.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10, 64-Bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz / AMD Ryzen 5
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX550
    • Storage: 5 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: WARDOGS - Supporter Pack
item.description:
Title: WARDOGS - Supporter Pack
Genre: Action , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , Simulation
Developer: BULKHEAD
Publisher: Team17
Franchise: WARDOGS , Team17
Release Date: Sep 10, 2026




About This Content

WARDOGS Early Access Supporters Pack offers additional cosmetic content to the base game for players who want to help support BULKHEAD and the future development of WARDOGS. There will be no monetization on WARDOGS during Early Access with the sole exception of this optional supporter edition.

The Supporter Pack includes;

  • 3 ‘Starter Weapon’ Camos;

  • Valkyra Branded A-91 Rifle Camo

  • Lonestar Branded Bushmaster Camo

  • Manticore Branded KH-2002 Camo

  • Littlebird Helicopter ‘Taxi’ Camo

  • Supporter Icon on scoreboard (can be hidden in settings)

  • Grenade Bobblehead

  • Helmet Bobblehead

To be extra clear on BULKHEAD’s stance re: monetization.

1. We will NOT monetize the game at any point during Early Access.

2. We will NEVER monetize in-game cash or gold bars, they must be earned through play.

3. We will NEVER allow you to directly purchase camos.
( camos should show that a player has worked hard to unlock that item not how much money they have)

Thankyou!

Thanks for being part of our community and considering purchasing the supporter edition.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Wardogs contains killing with weapons and melee combat.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel® Core i5 8600, AMD Ryzen 5 3500
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1660, Radeon RX 590
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p Low @ 60fps (Upscaled)
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel® Core i7 12700k, AMD Ryzen 7 5700x
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070, AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 50 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1440p Medium @ 70fps+ (Native) or 4k Medium @ 60fps+ (Upscaled)
